newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Bekaert jumps five percent.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Bekaert jumps five percent.

text.p: Shares in Belgian steel cord and wire maker Bekaert climbed 5.41 percent on Thursday with one trader putting it down to short covering by one London-based player.
"It's a technical correction because someone has had to cover himself. I see the share as totally negative in the short run," said the trader.
But a steel analyst at Bank Degroof said he was positive of the share. "I'm very positive on the share...it will outperform the market in coming years," Peter De Neve.
By 1350 GMT the share was up 5.05 percent at 22,350 francs, with a modest 43 million francs volume of Belgian shares.
